verdict.rationale: Brave ships an official MCP server that exposes web, local, image, video, news, LLM-context and summarizer tools ready for direct tool-call use. It also publishes first-party guides for Claude Desktop, Open WebUI, an official n8n node, Dify, OpenClaw and Claude Cowork on Bedrock, plus Skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and others. Its LLM Context endpoint is positioned as the default for tools and chatbots, and community users report it 'works great with OpenClaw' on the AI plan. missing for 10: explicitly published function-calling JSON schemas for OpenAI/Anthropic-style tool definitions (no OpenAPI spec found at probed paths), evidence of integrations with code-level agent frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and independent hands-on corroboration of the tool schemas themselves.
